shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/stele bearing raised relief
elongated curving raised forms that may read as animal bodies or limbs
a transverse/horizontal element near the top of the field
vertical orientation with motifs stacked one above another
justification: Both are upright slabs carrying raised relief with a horizontal element near the top and elongated vertical forms below, but that is about as far as the correspondence goes. A presents a legible, richly populated program of registers with profile quadrupeds, a bird with long neck, a snake-like reptile, a small anthropomorph and a zigzag band, whereas B shows only a few massive, coarse, unarticulated raised masses with no identifiable creatures, attributes or interactions.
